node.title: Rate-half sparse pinning, normal form, and coupled match rigidity
node.statement: At agreement a=k+tau in an RS code, every non-tangent MCA-bad slope of a pair supported on e<=n-a coordinates is pinned by one active match to a nonzero ambiguity polynomial z=h product_(x in Z)(X-x), with |Z|>=a-e, deg h<=e-tau-1, and T>=A-e+tau+1+u active matches under the same radius budget. Hence e>=tau+1. For the official rate-half row and q>=2^168, all tangent slopes fit floor(q/2^128), leaving exactly the non-tangent coupled system.
